reviews.comment: Took her for Writing About Lit and she was great! It was a discussion-based class, so she kept track of whether you spoke out during class discussions or not, meaning you needed to know what the reading was about. There were no exams, just a few papers, and a group project. She's super helpful with writing papers and she seems to care a lot!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: She takes attendance grades with only 3 unexcused absences allowed. Throughout the semester you will have 4 papers to write each longer than the previous one. Her lectures are pretty boring but easy as long as you show up. It consists of standard english things so the class is fairly straightforward
